version_1_0_gate.done_when: all ten MVP roadmaps are 100 and the new UI is live

runner.selection_policy: lowest roadmap number below 100, then first open or running slice

roadmaps.name: Runtime Closure Gates
roadmaps.why_not_100: Debian/systemd/restic backup evidence and Telegram allowed-chat text roundtrip are not executable in the current configured runtime.

next_slices.objective: Collect Debian systemd/restic updater and backup evidence without overclaiming Windows runtime behavior.
next_slices.blocker: Current runtime is Windows and lacks Debian/systemd/restic target details.

next_slices.objective: Run a redacted Telegram text intake and reply roundtrip.
next_slices.blocker: Bot token readiness exists, but allowed chat and polling/reply gates are absent.

roadmaps.name: Private Data / Nextcloud Memory Ingestion
roadmaps.why_not_100: Nextcloud/WebDAV configuration, source, target, disk budget, and no-delete dry-run are missing.

next_slices.objective: Verify redacted Nextcloud/WebDAV readiness and record exact missing inputs.
next_slices.blocker: .env has no Nextcloud/WebDAV marker and transfer inputs are not defined.

next_slices.objective: Run the smallest reversible transfer/readiness smoke after config is present.

roadmaps.name: System Health Checker Host-Agent
roadmaps.why_not_100: Host-Agent/local API config, install/start target, and snapshot endpoint are missing.

next_slices.objective: Validate host-agent config markers and prepare first live snapshot smoke.
next_slices.blocker: .env contains no Host-Agent or local API marker.

next_slices.objective: Install/start or query the host-agent and record a sanitized runtime snapshot.
next_slices.blocker: No concrete host target or install/start permission is defined.

roadmaps.name: Telegram Voice Pipeline
roadmaps.why_not_100: Allowed chat, polling, download, STT, and reply gates are missing.

next_slices.objective: Check live voice pipeline gates without downloading user audio.
next_slices.blocker: Only bot token readiness exists; no voice or reply gates are configured.

roadmaps.name: ORCA / Lens Naming & Backend Migration
roadmaps.why_not_100: Data-path migration needs a target and rollback decision; UI Lens wording waits for redesign.

next_slices.objective: Prepare final ORCA data-path cutover only after target and rollback are named.
next_slices.blocker: No concrete migration target or rollback plan is selected.

next_slices.objective: Rename Lens UI surfaces during the shared UI redesign.
next_slices.blocker: UI redesign is intentionally handled later.

roadmaps.name: PlanRuntime / Visual Planning Logic
roadmaps.why_not_100: Backend logic is closed; browser editor UI remains a shared redesign gate.

next_slices.objective: Build the browser proposal editor in the new UI.

roadmaps.name: Release / Distribution Evidence
roadmaps.why_not_100: Deploy/tag/distribution target and new UI live gate are missing.

next_slices.objective: Turn the evidence bundle into a concrete release/deploy/tag decision.
next_slices.blocker: No deploy/tag/distribution target is selected and UI live gate is false.

roadmaps.name: Image Tools Worker Final Smoke
roadmaps.why_not_100: Final successful remove-background smoke needs rembg in the isolated worker environment; UI remains later.

next_slices.objective: Run or prepare the final isolated worker remove-background smoke.
required_inputs: rembg installed or explicit install permission
next_slices.blocker: The current worker reports dependency_missing for rembg.
